subject: System Parameters / K_register: Max number of active (i.e. unexpired) registrations + ongoing registration attempts per bucket
summary: maintainRegistrations drops a Confirmed registration whose registrar left the bucket and refills it

anchors.text: # Drop tasks for peers that are no longer in this bucket (stale after refresh)

reason: A task sleeping through advertExpiry after Confirmed is cancelled and excluded from active when its registrar leaves the bucket, even though the registration is still live at the registrar, so the refill can push live registrations above K_register.

evidence: advisor (claude, image sha256:528f5707e8dd): One is cancelling live Confirmed registrations whose registrar left the bucket, the other is the lack of a per-registrar rejection memory in candidate selection; the fixes are different and neither closes the other.
